run_bloat_diff: run the bloat diff script to compare binary size changes between two git commits
run_bloat_diff_with_base: run the bloat diff script with a specific diff base commit to compare library bloat
build_grpc_libs: build the gRPC shared libraries using make and rename the output directory for bloat analysis
run_bloaty_analysis: run bloaty on compiled gRPC libraries to analyze compile units and symbol size differences
check_on_pr_bloat: post the bloat difference report to the pull request using check_on_pr utility
